title: 3D Pin
description: Card that tilts back as a glowing pin rises with a label chip and rippling rings.

a11y.motion: The card never tilts and the pin does not rise; on hover or focus the pin, chip and three static rings simply appear over the flat card.
a11y.keyboard: With href the whole card is one link; without it the root is a plain div and the effect shows while a link or button inside it has keyboard focus. The focused card gets a visible ring.
a11y.screenReader: The chip's title is real text read with the card content (it forms part of the link name when href is set); the beam, dot and rings are aria-hidden.
